biw_news.title: Architectural Evaluation of the New Italian Supercar Spaceframe Architecture
biw_news.summary: The Angelelli Automobili Tipo 829 structural layout is engineered to accommodate three distinct variants around a rigid chassis framework. Its multi-purpose structural design optimizes torsional rigidity across diverse driving dynamics.

biw_news.title: Evaluating the Chassis Integration and Powertrain Layout of the BMW M3 EV
biw_news.summary: The upcoming electric M3 leverages the Neue Klasse skateboard architecture to optimize battery structural enclosure placement. This integration significantly lowers the vehicle's center of gravity while maintaining high torsional rigidity.

biw_news.title: Chassis Stiffness and Lightweight Dynamics in the Toyota GR Yaris
biw_news.summary: The GR Yaris employs specialized spot-welding patterns and structural adhesives to enhance body shell rigidity. Its multi-material body construction balances lightweight execution with high crashworthiness performance.

biw_news.title: Structural Analysis of the Bentley Torcal Dedicated EV Platform
biw_news.summary: Bentley's first battery-electric vehicle utilizes a robust skateboard chassis architecture designed to house high-capacity battery packs safely. The underfloor structure acts as a primary load-bearing element, increasing overall chassis stiffness.

biw_news.title: Platform Engineering and Body-in-White Evolution in the New BMW 3 Series
biw_news.summary: The internal combustion variants of the new 3 Series adopt Neue Klasse structural design principles to streamline manufacturing. The BIW architecture features optimized load paths and advanced high-strength steel grades for enhanced crash safety.

biw_news.title: Subframe and Suspension Hardpoint Rigidity in the 2026 Subaru WRX
biw_news.summary: The Subaru WRX chassis utilizes reinforced subframe mounting points to minimize suspension deflection under high lateral loads. Optimized chassis hardpoints ensure precise kinematic control and structural durability during aggressive track use.
